checked: Clause, subject, and verb are defined first. Independent and dependent clauses precede all sentence-type definitions. Filipino simuno and panaguri are explained before clause analysis; connector purposes precede formation and sequencing tasks.

Core Concept explains complete versus incomplete thoughts, equal-clause coordination, and each structure through clause counts. The Filipino subsection gives formation procedures for tambalan and langkapan and meaning-based choices for causal and narrative connectors; worked examples apply them.

Simple and compound exclude dependent clauses; complex and compound-complex specify both counts. The shortcut requires a marker to introduce a subject-and-verb clause, and since Monday illustrates the limit. Narrative markers are explicitly said not always to add clauses.
